title: Políticas, representaciones y memorias entre Argentina y Alemania
summary: The circulation of knowledge, human rights and (post)memories, as well as the processes of cooperation, integration and participation are the three thematic focuses that make up this book, a product of academic cooperation in the area of ​​humanities and social sciences between the National University of La Plata and the University Rostock. The first axis, coordinated by Clara Ruvituso, brings together works that illuminate the circulation of knowledge from different perspectives and medialities. Women, youth, migrants, activists, translators and cartoonists are the protagonists of stories circulating in multiple directions and spaces. The second axis, coordinated by Nicolás Welschinger, intertwines two themes that in the last ten years have occupied a central space in the public debate: the demands for memory, truth and justice of the human rights movements and the debates on violence and gender inequality promoted by the feminist movement. The third axis, coordinated by Christian Pfeiffer, explores how different actors and communities show their capacity to face new global challenges such as violence against women, the integration of refugees, labor dynamics and the management of essential resources such as water.
